content:
I didn't open a new PR because this one already exists: [madsbolaris/trailvault-capture-test#36](https://github.com/madsbolaris/trailvault-capture-test/pull/36), "Add bouncing ball visualization". It's open against `main` and comes from the branch you're on now (`add-bouncing-ball-visualization`).

It adds one file, [visualizations/bouncing-ball.html](visualizations/bouncing-ball.html) (216 lines). It's a single page with no dependencies that animates a ball on an HTML canvas, with:
- sliders for gravity and bounciness
- pause and reset buttons
- click to throw the ball
- the ball squashes when it hits the ground
- a shadow and a motion trail

A second PR would add the same file again, so the simplest thing is to keep using #36. If you want a different version, I can open a new PR from a separate branch instead.
